title: Polymorph Continuation
description: Unofficial NeoForge 1.21.11 continuation port of Illusive Soulworks' Polymorph, with full credit to the original project.
body:
# Polymorph Continuation

Polymorph Continuation is an unofficial community port of Illusive Soulworks' Polymorph for Minecraft 1.21.11 on NeoForge.

Polymorph solves recipe conflicts by letting players choose between all valid outputs that share the same ingredients. This beta continuation build keeps that behavior available for newer NeoForge environments while preserving attribution and the original LGPL licensing.

## Credits

- Original mod: [Polymorph](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymorph)
- Original source: [illusivesoulworks/polymorph](https://github.com/illusivesoulworks/polymorph)
- Original author: Illusive Soulworks / TheIllusiveC4

This continuation is not affiliated with or endorsed by Illusive Soulworks.

## Beta testing notes

Validated against NeoForge 21.11.42 for Minecraft 1.21.11 with a conflict datapack covering inventory crafting, crafting table, furnace, smoker, blast furnace, and crafter selection behavior.
